name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Claude Code Infrastructure Showcase
short_description: Explore the Claude Code infrastructure with a focus on skill auto-activation, hooks, and agents. This repository showcases practical examples to enhance your understanding and implementation of AI-driven solutions.
author: diet103

sections.overview:
The claude-code-infrastructure-showcase is a production-ready reference library demonstrating how to build and integrate AI agent skills within Claude Code environments. It includes 5 modular skills, 6 hooks for skill auto-activation, 10 specialized agents, and 3 slash commands designed to streamline development workflows. The repository provides comprehensive guides on frontend and backend integration patterns, including layered architecture, async/await handling, database patterns with Prisma, middleware implementation, and error tracking with Sentry. Developers can cherry-pick components or use the complete infrastructure as a foundation for implementing AI-driven solutions. The showcase includes structured examples using standardized patterns suitable for community customization and production deployment.
Implementing skill auto-activation to enhance the responsiveness of AI agents.
Creating hooks that facilitate seamless integration between different components of your AI system.
Developing custom agents to automate specific tasks tailored to your project needs.
Optimizing AI workflows using Shell scripts to improve execution speed and reliability.
sections.usage:
```
Explore the Claude Code infrastructure for [PROJECT_NAME] with a focus on skill auto-activation, hooks, and agents. Provide practical examples to enhance my understanding and implementation of AI-driven solutions. Specifically, I need insights on how to integrate [SPECIFIC_FEATURE] into my existing workflow.
```
Copy

```
The Claude Code infrastructure is designed to streamline the integration of AI-driven solutions into your projects. For instance, if you're working on a customer success platform, you can leverage the Hook (Sales Forecasting) tool to automate the analysis of customer interactions. The infrastructure showcases how skill auto-activation can be used to trigger specific actions based on predefined criteria. For example, when a customer's engagement metrics drop below a certain threshold, the system can automatically activate a retention strategy. Agents within the infrastructure can be programmed to handle routine tasks, such as sending follow-up emails or updating customer records, freeing up your team to focus on more strategic activities. Practical examples include setting up auto-activation for high-priority tasks and configuring agents to monitor key performance indicators in real-time.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
